admin.description: Choose how new research runs use Qwen, Gemini and Claude.
admin.routingHelp: This policy applies to new research runs across all workspaces.
admin.primaryHelp: The selected provider handles analysis and native web retrieval.
admin.fallbackHelp: Try the fallback provider if the primary has a configuration, credit, availability, or retrieval failure.
admin.fallbackLimit: One-way fallback only. If a reservation is rejected before sending a request, the other configured provider may be tried within the same budget. Validation, evidence, and post-request budget failures never trigger fallback.
admin.saved: Provider settings saved. New research runs will use this policy.
admin.saveFailed: Settings could not be saved. Your changes are still here; please try again.
admin.notConfigured: A selected provider is missing its server credentials. Choose a configured provider and disable fallback, or ask the project owner to check the project variables.
admin.accessExpired: Your administrator session is no longer authorized. Sign in again before saving.
admin.loadFailed: Settings could not be refreshed. Reload them before making changes.
admin.credentialsHelp: Keys stay on the server. Configured means credentials are present, not that billing or provider access has been verified.
admin.accessHelp: Administrators are identified by a server-managed role claim set with the service role or in the Supabase dashboard. Email addresses and user-editable metadata never grant access.
admin.scope: Initialized research keeps its saved model choices, source settings and budget. Evidence requirements and development access are unchanged.
admin.workspaceEndpoint: The server replaces {WorkspaceId} with the configured Beijing workspace ID. Keys never reach the browser.
admin.modelBudget: Max and Argon use more of the same research budget and may hit the existing limit sooner. Native search context and query costs are estimates, not provider-enforced caps. Google Search requires paid-tier access.
admin.budgetHelp: Hard cap on model and search spend for each new research run, between {min} and {max} USD. Existing runs keep the cap they started with.
admin.costEstimate: Estimated cost of a complete run: about {expected}. Set a per-run budget of at least {required}: every reservation fits, with 10% headroom so a change to the estimate does not move runs to another model.
admin.budgetTooLow: {model} cannot finish a run within this budget with headroom: it needs at least {required}. Raise the budget or choose a less expensive model; otherwise runs move to the fallback model or stop before their report.
admin.fallbackOverBudget: {model} needs at least {required} to finish a run, so it will not be used as a fallback at this budget.
admin.budgetTooLowSaved: This budget is too low for the selected primary model. Raise the budget or choose a less expensive model.
admin.disclosure: Saving updates the AI-provider sections of the Privacy Policy and Support page immediately. A provider change can change where research data is processed, including mainland China; tell users before a change that materially affects them.
admin.verifyEstimate: Checking one idea (Verify my idea) is expected to cost about {expected} and needs a per-run budget of at least {required}.
admin.sourcesHelp: Breadth decides where research looks for evidence; depth decides how much it reads. Changes apply to new runs and change the cost estimate below.
admin.breadthHelp: Which kinds of independent sources each search prefers, and how it treats vendor and older pages.
admin.sourceKindsHelp: At least one type stays selected. Unselected types can still appear in results; they are just not asked for.
admin.sectorCommunities: Look where buyers discuss their own work
admin.sectorCommunitiesHelp: Steers queries and searches toward the practitioner forums, professional bodies and trade press of the brief's industries, where first-hand buyer pain is mostly published. On by default; turn it off to search as before.
admin.alternativesSearchHelp: Every idea also gets a search for what buyers already use or pay for today, as Verify my idea does. Doubles the searches in a discovery run.
admin.vendorPagesHelp: Vendor pages never count as independent proof of demand. Excluding them leaves more room for independent sources.
admin.recencyHelp: Older sources are still used when nothing recent exists.
admin.depthHelp: How many ideas a discovery run researches and how many pages it reads for each.
admin.candidatesHelp: Fewer ideas cost less and finish sooner; more ideas give more chances that one passes the evidence rules.
admin.pagesPerIdeaHelp: More pages give each idea more chances to find independent support, and add classification cost. Verify my idea reads twice as many.
admin.sourcesSummary: A discovery run makes up to {searches} searches for {ideas} ideas and reads up to {pages} of {results} results for each; Verify my idea reads up to {verifyPages} pages.
admin.sourcesGate: These settings change what is searched and read, never the evidence rules: an opportunity still needs supporting sources from at least two independent domains, at least one of them not a vendor.
admin.fallbackProviderHelp: The provider that takes over when the primary fails. A run falls back at most once.
